meta.purpose: Free and paid things to do in the preferred Feb–Mar 2027 window, for a couple. Only officially sourced facts.
meta.social_link_policy: Social profiles are listed only where the operator's own website links to them. Where no official profile could be confirmed the cell is blank and flagged rather than guessed.

activities.name: Fountains of Bellagio
activities.venue: Bellagio — the lake in front of the hotel
activities.address: 3600 S. Las Vegas Blvd., Las Vegas, NV 89109
activities.price_note: No ticket required; publicly viewable from the Strip sidewalk and the Bellagio bridge.

hours.mon_fri: Every 30 minutes from 3:00 PM to 7:30 PM, then every 15 minutes from 8:00 PM to midnight
hours.sat_sun_holidays: Every 30 minutes from 12:00 PM to 7:30 PM, then every 15 minutes from 8:00 PM to midnight

activities.exceptions: Shows are cancelled in high winds and other inclement weather. Schedule subject to change.

activities.name: High Roller Observation Wheel
activities.address: 3535 S. Las Vegas Blvd., Las Vegas, NV 89109
activities.price: Adult daytime $23.50; Adult anytime $34.75; Happy Half Hour (21+, open bar) $60; Youth 4–12 $8.50 daytime / $17.50 anytime; children 3 and under free
activities.price_note: Prices exclude tax and fees. For 2 adults the daytime cost is therefore $47.00 plus tax/fees and the anytime cost is $69.50 plus tax/fees.
activities.cost_couple_note: Computed as 2 × the officially published adult price. Tax and fees excluded.

hours.daily: Operates daily; the observation wheel runs through the day and evening. The official page publishes a calendar that could not be captured as a static weekly table, so exact daily opening times are left blank.

activities.exceptions: Height 550 ft. 28 air-conditioned cabins, up to 40 people per cabin. One rotation takes about 30 minutes and boarding does not stop the wheel. Nevada residents get 20% off standard tickets in January and June before 5 PM with valid ID.
activities.booking_required: Not required, but timed tickets are sold and the official page links to Ticketmaster

activities.exceptions: This is the only major Sphere residency whose confirmed run fully covers the 15 February – 23 March 2027 planning window. Competitors do not: the Eagles run 13 Nov 2026 – 23 Jan 2027 (ends before the window), Backstreet Boys 26 Dec 2026 – 2 Jan 2027 (ends before the window), and John Mayer 8 Apr – 12 Jun 2027 (starts after the window).
